name: plateau

development.what: the tuning seeds and the tuning planes: the control of (a) and the three singles of (b) ran here, and the combination was chosen from their held-out scores; every development run of this build (--no-fresh) ran here too

heldOut.what: the held-out seeds and planes (new task draws for both planes, searched and held-out): built after the combination was chosen; the tuning never built, searched or scored them, and no development run touched them. The repeat re-runs the same command, so the second run grades the same held-out seeds again; nothing was tuned between the runs

retired.exposedBy: a 3 s smoke run (--wall-s 3 --tune-seeds 2 --arm-seeds 2 --fresh-seeds 2) of an earlier build of bench/plateau.mjs at 2026-09-27T01:30Z
retired.why: those strings were exposed by that smoke run, so no run of this build uses them; the held-out side moved to the heldout namespace

split.withinEveryRun: the held-out draw of a plane is read only to write a row; selection, the restart clock, the hall of fame and which migrant is offered read the searched matrix and the generation count alone (test/plateau.test.mjs swaps the held-out draw and gets the identical searched trajectory in every arm)

bar.rule: on the held-out seeds, the chosen combination beats the control's mean final held-out score by more than the seed-to-seed noise (the larger sample sd of the two arms) on BOTH planes, and its mean plateau generation is later than the control's on both; and the repeat: the bar command run back to back on this build moved the difference by less than the smallest seed noise on every plane
bar.control: the same loop with novelty, transfer and restart all off, on the same seeds and the same planes, for the same budget, run in the same batch of worker threads

statement: One organism-year is declared to be one generation of the whole population (64 children) on a plane. Two planes the plain search does not saturate were run for 241,675 generations of each plane per run (a generation budget: the same seed draws the same search; wall time is printed, never budgeted), one generation of each in turn, with a row every 200 generations: the grid plane (tasks/grid.mjs, 6175 components, 4 searched draws of 160 tasks, a length cap of 64, scored on a held-out draw of 160 tasks) and a synthetic cover plane (2048 generated components over 384 task families, 4 searched draws of 256 tasks, a length cap of 48, scored on a fresh draw of 256 tasks), the same shapes on the tuning and the held-out seeds. On 5 tuning seeds the plain control last rose on the held-out score at generation 28,241 +- 18,392 (12.80 +- 8.34 s of wall) on grid and generation 138,081 +- 80,379 (67.19 +- 38.87 s of wall) on synthetic, ending at 122.40 +- 0.89 and 224.60 +- 4.51 (mean +- seed sd). Three interventions each ran beside the control on the first 5 of those seeds: behaviour-keyed archive cells (novelty), descriptor-matched elites crossing between the planes every generation (transfer) and a re-seed from the archive's most distant cells after 24,168 generations without a searched rise (restart). Final held-out on grid: novelty 121.00 against 122.40 (plateau generation 3,041 against 28,241); transfer 122.20 against 122.40 (plateau generation 27,801 against 28,241); restart 122.00 against 122.40 (plateau generation 56,041 against 28,241). On synthetic: novelty 224.20 against 224.60 (plateau generation 126,081 against 138,081); transfer 224.40 against 224.60 (plateau generation 142,681 against 138,081); restart 222.80 against 224.60 (plateau generation 125,361 against 138,081). By a rule fixed before the runs the singles chose transfer (no single was at or above the control on both planes, so the single with the largest summed gain was graded). On 5 held-out seeds, on planes built from task seeds the tuning never touched, transfer ended at 118.00 against the control's 119.20 on grid (noise 3.16, plateau generation 12,001 against 56,361, at 5.15 s against 27.12 s of wall) and 216.40 against 217.80 on synthetic (noise 7.05, plateau generation 92,601 against 80,801, at 45.87 s against 38.70 s of wall). The combination bar (beat the control by more than the seed noise and plateau at a later generation, on both planes) is not met. The machine was shared with other builders, so the wall seconds are contended seconds and move between runs; the generations do not. This verdict is bar run 3 of this build (sha256 209ce2ca25abcf1f, 91 source files); across those 3 runs the bar was met in 0, the singles chose transfer 3 (runs per combination), and on the held-out seeds grid beat the noise in 0 and plateaued later in 0 (control final 119.20, combination final 118.00, control plateau 27.12..31.77 s, combination plateau 5.15..5.65 s); synthetic beat the noise in 0 and plateaued later in 3 (control final 217.80, combination final 216.40, control plateau 38.70..45.07 s, combination plateau 45.87..53.63 s). THE REPEAT: run by run, transfer minus control was -1.20 and -1.20 and -1.20 on grid (noise 3.16 and 3.16 and 3.16, a move of 0.00; the control's plateau second moved 4.65 s and its plateau generation 0) and -1.40 and -1.40 and -1.40 on synthetic (noise 7.05 and 7.05 and 7.05, a move of 0.00; the control's plateau second moved 6.37 s and its plateau generation 0). The largest move of the difference, 0.00 on grid, is under the noise on both planes, and the runs drew the same search (equal digests). barMet is false. No model was called.

budget.note: a generation budget: every arm runs the same generations of each plane, rows and the restart clock count generations, and wall time is printed, never budgeted

build.rule: sha256 over every file reachable from bench/plateau.mjs through relative imports (generations/plateau.mjs sourceClosure); two bar runs are one build only when the hashes are equal

repeat.rule: the bar command run back to back on one build; the move of a number is its max minus its min over the runs; barMet needs at least two runs and, on every plane, a move of the combination-minus-control difference under the smallest seed noise any run printed there

declaration.declaration: one organism-year is one generation of the whole population on a plane, so organism-years equal generations
